description:
User decision 2026-09-30: a `notuning` run must not override Spark's default configuration. Today `configure_for_benchmark` (spark.py ~L659, lakesail.py ~L526) always calls `apply_spark_olap_runtime_conf` (_spark_helpers.py ~L70-101), which sets five AQE/CBO keys in every mode; Spark's defaults for spark.sql.cbo.enabled and spark.sql.cbo.joinReorder.enabled are false. That is a curated optimisation pack running in the baseline, the same inversion ADR-003 (docs/development/tuning-adr-003-baseline-and-single-renderer.md) fixed for ClickHouse (see benchbox/platforms/clickhouse/tuning.py ~L44-99: harness settings in every mode, optimisation pack gated on self.tuning_enabled). Velox's configure_for_benchmark (velox.py ~L563-576) sets the CBO keys inline, records nothing and does not use the shared helper.

Scope:
- Gate the CBO pack (and any AQE/shuffle values that differ from the engine default on the supported Spark versions) on tuning_enabled, for spark, velox and lakesail.
- Review other BenchBox-originated session values set in every mode: `adaptive_enabled` default at session build (spark.py ~L453-459), `shuffle_partitions` default 200, and the joinorder-only `broadcast_threshold = -1` (spark.py ~L349-356). Keep only engine-mandatory settings (warehouse dir, table-format extensions/catalogs, the Gluten plugin and off-heap settings) and record them in the ledger as harness-required so they are visible and not mistaken for tuning.
- Route Velox through the shared helper so its session settings are recorded.
- Baseline Spark and LakeSail bundles will gain a ledger payload; keep `overall_status` meaningful (Opus suggested a `harness_default` mechanism excluded from overall_status) - decide and document.
- This changes baseline numbers. ADR-003 reconciliation: decide whether TUNING_POLICY_GENERATION (benchbox/core/tuning/policy_generation.py) needs a new generation, and ask the user before bumping it. Document the comparability break for old Spark baselines.
